chapter.heading: 1 Peter 5
Shepherd the Flock of God
chapter.v: a witness of the sufferings of Christ, as well as a partaker in the glory that is going to be revealed:
not for shameful gain, but eagerly;
“God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”
Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God so that at the proper time he may exalt you,
like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
the same kinds of suffering are being experienced by your brotherhood throughout the world.
To him be the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
Peace to all of you who are in Christ.

footnotes.footnote: 5:2 Some manuscripts omit *as God would have you*
